summary: Frontend E2E test for the new Google-Drive-style File Browser features on OPS_sftp: image thumbnails (list + grid), right-click context menu, kebab list menu, rename dialog, move-to and copy-to folder-picker (MoveCopyDialog) with invalidTarget guards, plus regression preview. All flows passed end-to-end and sample files were restored to their original layout.
critical_code_review_comments: ThumbImage.jsx: object URLs are stored in a module-level cache and never revoked. For long sessions with many images this leaks memory. Consider LRU eviction with URL.revokeObjectURL on drop.

MoveCopyDialog invalidTarget only forbids self/descendant for is_dir and same-parent for MOVE. Copying a folder into itself/descendant is not blocked (would recurse). Backend also validates but a UI guard would be nicer.
Files.jsx doRename builds dst by string-splitting item.path; behaves correctly for POSIX but keep in mind cross-backend paths.
ItemMenu wraps EACH row/card in its own ContextMenu; fine functionally but could be a single portal-based menu for perf with large lists.
seed_data_creation: Transient: renamed notes.txt->notes2.txt->notes.txt; moved data.csv into upload/ then back; copied config.json into upload/ then deleted the copy. Root layout restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login -> click 'File Browser' sidebar -> click storage button 'OPS_sftp' (get_by_role button name='OPS_sftp'). List view = view-list-button, grid = view-grid-button. Right-click via locator.click(button='right') on file-row-<name> or file-card-<name> opens ctx-menu-<name> with ctx-{preview,download,rename,move,copy,delete}-<name>. Rename dialog: data-testid rename-dialog, rename-input, rename-confirm-button. Move/Copy dialog: move-copy-dialog, move-folder-<name>, move-copy-confirm (disabled for invalid target), move-copy-close. List kebab: more-<name> opens shadcn DropdownMenu with Rename/Move to…/Copy to…/Delete role=menuitem entries. Root breadcrumb button = active storage name inside data-testid=breadcrumbs.
